text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Fisheries (Piranha) Regulations. Piranha not to be kept etc.
No person shall keep, breed, sell, purchase, import into or export from Brunei Darussalam the species of fish known as piranha. Piranha not to be released into river etc.
No person shall release any piranha into any river, stream, canal, channel, watercourse, reservoir, lake or other body of water. Penalty
Any person who contravenes regulation 2 or 3 is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $50,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year or both. [S 25/2009]
